_comment: Adit MCP servers ctxgit hands to the chat agent (Claude and Codex alike).
Adding a server later is a data change: append an entry, nothing else.
id       server name the agent sees (tools arrive as mcp__<id>__*)
cwd      working directory; relative paths resolve against `root`
root     optional base for cwd/args (defaults to `aditRoot` below)
env      values may reference the host environment as ${VAR};
an unresolved ${VAR} makes that one server inactive rather
requires env vars that must resolve for the server to be offered
enabled  set false to keep an entry without offering it
Secrets belong in this directory's .env (git-ignored), not here.

servers.label: ADIT 원격 MCP (api.adit.now) — OAuth
note: Cognito OAuth로 보호된 원격 MCP다 (Bearer). ctxgit은 OAuth 플로우를 구현하지
않으므로 토큰은 각 CLI가 소유한다. 한 번만 아래를 실행해 로그인한 뒤
claude mcp add --transport http adit-remote https://api.adit.now/mcp
두 CLI 모두 user scope에 등록되면 ctxgit이 그대로 상속하므로, enabled를
켜지 않아도 채팅 턴에서는 이미 쓸 수 있다. 켜는 것은 Extensions 토글로
